title: Canva launches Magic Layers, an AI tool that turns a flat bitmap image into a fully editable Canva project by extracting text and objects into individual layers (Jesus Diaz/Fast Company)
summary: Jesus Diaz / Fast Company: Canva launches Magic Layers, an AI tool that turns a flat bitmap image into a fully editable Canva project by extracting text and objects into individual layers — The newly launched Magic Layers feature dissects flat images into native objects, putting an end to the frustrating era of pixel-locked assets.
